text: {"label":"Disseminating and Expanding Behavior Science","definition":"Work on spreading behavior science beyond its usual settings through public communication, plain language, social media, entrepreneurship, technology, artificial intelligence, community psychology and public policy, broadening its reach and impact.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on outreach, accessibility and extending behavior science into new settings and technologies, not on qualitative research methods, theoretical dimensions of the science, or the history and identity of applied behavior analysis."}
